sculpt_rubble_heap.author: sculpted for this project
sculpt_rubble_heap.notes: Rubble heap for the rubble puzzles (gameplay/wilds-puzzles.js): a rockfall of split angular blocks built from exact planes (facet kit), bevelled weathered edges, paler fracture faces, talus chips, moss on the oldest low blocks. Neutral stone ~#9b9b9b (the game tints it per site). Origin = ground centre (the chest), ~3.6 m across, ~1.9 m tall. LOD tris 3084 / 1353 / 349. Vertex colour only (COLOR_0 linear rgb, written once).
